how_to_apply: Candidates must complete the prescribed apprenticeship registration before applying for the SDSC SHAR apprenticeship through the UMANG portal. The official notification provides the following procedure.
Visit the NATS portal at nats.education.gov.in or the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme portal at www.apprenticeship.gov.in, as applicable.
Register on the appropriate apprenticeship portal using the required details and upload the applicable Degree/Diploma certificate and valid government-issued identification documents.
After successful registration, retain the generated Enrolment Number or Apprenticeship Registration Number.
Ensure that your Aadhaar number is linked to your bank account and enabled for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
Visit the UMANG portal at web.umang.gov.in/landing/.
Register or log in to UMANG and search for SDSC SHAR Apprenticeship.
Select the appropriate apprenticeship position and enter the required details.
Upload the relevant supporting documents in JPG, JPEG or PNG format, not exceeding 1 MB per document, as specified in the notification.
Upload the required photograph, signature and category certificates in the format prescribed on UMANG.
Carefully verify the educational qualification, marks, passing year, category and other details before submitting the application.
Submit the online application on or before 26 November 2026 and retain a copy for future reference.
Important: No changes will be permitted after final submission. Applications submitted through any mode other than the prescribed online portal will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 400 apprenticeship positions are distributed across six training categories. Trade Apprentices account for the largest number of positions, followed by Non-Engineering Graduates and DCCP apprentices.

rows.apprenticeship_category: Diploma in Commercial and Computer Practice (DCCP)

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026 Discipline-Wise Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notification provides separate position counts for each engineering branch, academic discipline and technical trade. Applicants should select the category matching their completed qualification rather than applying for an unrelated trade or discipline.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026 Category-Wise Reservation
content_sections.text: The official notification specifies reservation across Unreserved (UR), Other Backward Classes (OBC), Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST) and Economically Weaker Sections (EWS). Reservation is applied at the apprenticeship category level according to Government of India norms.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the educational qualifications prescribed for their apprenticeship category. Engineering and Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentices require the relevant degree, while Technician, Trade and Vocational Apprentices must possess the specified diploma, trade or vocational qualification. Important Eligibility Conditions: Graduate and Diploma Apprenticeship candidates must have passed their relevant qualifications in 2022 or later . Applicants with sandwich-course certificates, short-term/certificate courses or those pursuing higher studies are not eligible under the stated conditions. Candidates who have already completed or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training, have one year or more of experience in an organization, or have been terminated from or withdrawn from apprenticeship training are also not eligible. Only Indian nationals may apply.

rows.educational_qualification: B.E./B.Tech in the relevant discipline from a recognized university/institute, first class with at least 60% marks or 6.32 CGPA.
B.Sc in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Electronics or Computer Science, or B.Com/B.A. from a recognized university/institute, first class with at least 60% marks or 6.32 CGPA.
Diploma in the relevant discipline from a recognized university/institute, first class with at least 60% marks or 6.32 CGPA.
SSLC/SSC with ITI/NTC in the relevant trade from NCVT.
Certificate in the relevant vocational course involving two years of study after secondary school education, recognized by AICTE.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The uploaded apprenticeship notification does not specify a separate minimum or maximum numerical age limit. Candidates should follow the eligibility requirements under the applicable apprenticeship rules and the official application portals. Applicants should not assume an age relaxation or upper age limit unless it is officially prescribed.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Salary / Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend according to their category during the prescribed training period. The highest specified stipend is Rs. 12,300 per month for Graduate Apprentices, while Trade and Vocational Apprentices receive Rs. 9,600 per month. Note: The notification lists DCCP as a separate vacancy category but does not separately specify its stipend in the educational qualification and stipend table. Candidates should verify the applicable amount through SDSC SHAR.

rows.monthly_stipend: Refer to the applicable category details in the official portal

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification does not prescribe a separate application fee amount. Candidates should refer to the official apprenticeship registration portals for any applicable instructions before submitting their applications.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprenticeship 2026 will be based on academic merit and document verification. The notification provides for category-wise merit lists using the marks obtained in the relevant educational qualification. It does not announce a separate written examination or interview as part of the stated selection procedure. Academic Merit List: Merit lists will be prepared based on academic scores separately for UR, OBC, SC, ST and EWS categories. Discipline-Wise Shortlisting: Applicants will be shortlisted according to their position in the merit list for the relevant discipline, branch, trade or subject. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend document verification with original certificates. Final Consideration: Only candidates who attend verification and satisfy all prescribed eligibility requirements will be considered for apprenticeship engagement. No travelling allowance will be provided to candidates attending document verification. Selection is subject to satisfactory verification of qualifications, marks and supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026 Training Duration
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship training duration is 12 months , commencing from the execution of the apprenticeship contract. Selected candidates must execute the contract in accordance with the Apprentices Act and submit a medical fitness certificate at the time of joining. Completion of apprenticeship training does not provide any claim to temporary, ad hoc or permanent employment at SDSC SHAR or any other ISRO/Department of Space centre or unit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must complete the prescribed apprenticeship registration before applying for the SDSC SHAR apprenticeship through the UMANG portal. The official notification provides the following procedure. Visit the NATS portal at nats.education.gov.in or the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme portal at www.apprenticeship.gov.in , as applicable. Register on the appropriate apprenticeship portal using the required details and upload the applicable Degree/Diploma certificate and valid government-issued identification documents. After successful registration, retain the generated Enrolment Number or Apprenticeship Registration Number. Ensure that your Aadhaar number is linked to your bank account and enabled for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Visit the UMANG portal at web.umang.gov.in/landing/ . Register or log in to UMANG and search for SDSC SHAR Apprenticeship . Select the appropriate apprenticeship position and enter the required details. Upload the relevant supporting documents in JPG, JPEG or PNG format, not exceeding 1 MB per document, as specified in the notification. Upload the required photograph, signature and category certificates in the format prescribed on UMANG. Carefully verify the educational qualification, marks, passing year, category and other details before submitting the application. Submit the online application on or before 26 November 2026 and retain a copy for future reference. Important: No changes will be permitted after final submission. Applications submitted through any mode other than the prescribed online portal will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should prepare the documents applicable to their apprenticeship category before beginning registration. The notification requires relevant educational certificates, identification documents and supporting category documents, where applicable. 10th / SSC Certificate Intermediate Certificate, where applicable ITI / NTC Certificate, where applicable Diploma Certificate and Marksheets, where applicable B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc, B.Com or B.A. Certificates and Marksheets, where applicable Relevant Vocational Course Certificate, where applicable Valid Government-Issued Identity Proof Recent Photograph and Signature Valid SC/ST/OBC Certificate, if applicable EWS Income and Asset Certificate valid for 2026-27, if applicable PwBD Certificate and Unique Disability Identity Card, if applicable NATS / Apprenticeship Registration Number The notification specifies JPG/JPEG/PNG format with a maximum file size of 1 MB for the listed supporting educational documents. Photograph, signature and category documents must follow the format and size instructions displayed on UMANG.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Links
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates should use the official apprenticeship registration portals and UMANG application portal. The notification also directs candidates to the ISRO/SDSC SHAR website for subsequent updates, corrigenda and additional instructions.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SDSC SHAR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 November 2026. Applications opened on 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SDSC SHAR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 400 vacancies: 50 Engineering Graduate Apprentice, 60 Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentice, 35 Technician Apprentice (Diploma), 60 Diploma (DCCP), 180 Trade Apprentice, 15 Vocational Apprentice.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SDSC SHAR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 12300 for Engineering Graduate Apprentice, 12300 for Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentice, 10900 for Technician Apprentice (Diploma), 9600 for Trade Apprentice, 9600 for Vocational Apprentice.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.E/B.Tech, or B.Sc./B.Com./B.A., or Diploma in first class with minimum 60% marks/6.32 CGPA (passed in 2022 or later); SSLC/SSC+ITI/NTC from NCVT for Trade Apprentice; AICTE-recognised two-year vocational certificate for Vocational Apprentice. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian Nationals need to apply. Aadhaar number must be seeded with bank account and enabled for DBT. Graduate and Diploma applicants must have passed the qualification in 2022 or thereafter.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Holders of sandwich course certificates, short term/certificate courses, etc. Applicants pursuing higher studies. Those who have already undergone or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Those having experience of one year or more in any organisation.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Category-wise (UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS) merit list based on academic score for each apprenticeship category. Shortlisting by position in the merit list against the respective discipline/branch/trade/subject. Document verification. Reservation as per Government of India norms applied at apprenticeship category level.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Training period of 12 months from execution of the contract of Apprenticeship. Selected applicants must execute a contract of Apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Amendment Act 1973. No claim for any adhoc/temporary/permanent employment in SDSC SHAR or ISRO/DOS after training.

faq.question: Q10. Will ISRO provide permanent employment after completing the apprenticeship?
faq.answer: No. The notification states that completion of apprenticeship training does not entitle candidates to claim regular, temporary or permanent employment in ISRO, SDSC SHAR or the Department of Space.
